description:
Browser automation, built for the agentic era. Real browser profiles your AI agents drive, on your own machine.

Browser automation, built for the agentic era. Scalebrowser gives your AI agents real browser profiles they can drive, workflows they build and run on their own, and logins they use without ever seeing a password.
The browsers run on your own Windows machine instead of a vendor's cloud, and agents connect over MCP, a REST API or the Python and Node SDKs.
A Scalebrowser account is required; the Free plan needs no card.
